name: @mason-gallery/monorepo
description: A multi-platform image viewer with masonry layout

scripts.gen:icons: cd packages/desktop && bunx tauri icon ../../public/logo/logo.svg -o src-tauri/icons
scripts.build:desktop: bun run gen:icons && bun run --filter @mason-gallery/desktop build
scripts.build:cli: bun run --filter @mason-gallery/web build && bun run --filter mason-gallery build
scripts.publish:npm: bun run build:cli && cd packages/cli && npm publish
